item.title: ▫️ Tsentr Group's guards break AFU resistance and take prisoners in close combat Servicemen of an assault detachment of the 80th Guards Tank Regiment (90th Guards Tank Division, Ts
item.description: Tsentr Group's guards break AFU resistance and take prisoners in close combat ▫️ Servicemen of an assault detachment of the 80th Guards Tank Regiment (90th Guards Tank Division, Tsentr Group of Forces) captured several AFU servicemen in Dnepropetrovsk direction of the special military operation. ▫️ During a combat mission, the assault detachments detect the enemy's camouflaged positions with manpower and destroy them both from the air with FPV drones and in direct contact at the positions with fire from organic weapons. ❗️ Before destroying the enemy, Russian servicemen always offer Ukrainian soldiers the choice to surrender voluntarily. The stormers try to take the captured servicemen to their unit, keeping them alive even under the strikes of AFU drones. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

▫️
Servicemen of an assault detachment of the 80th Guards Tank Regiment (90th Guards Tank Division, Tsentr Group of Forces)
captured several AFU servicemen
in Dnepropetrovsk direction of the special military operation.
▫️
During a combat mission, the assault detachments
detect the enemy's camouflaged positions with manpower and destroy them
both from the air with FPV drones and in direct contact at the positions with fire from organic weapons.
❗️
Before destroying the enemy,
Russian servicemen always offer Ukrainian soldiers the choice to surrender voluntarily.
The stormers try to take the captured servicemen to their unit,
keeping them alive even under the strikes of AFU drones.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, and an airmobile brigade of the AFU close to Rubezhnoye, Metallovka, and Berezhnoye in Kharkov region. 💥 In Sumy region, formations of three mechanised brigades of the AFU were hit near Khoten, Ivolzhanskoye, and Nikolskoye (Sumy region). ▪️ The enemy lost more than 165 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one radar station. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Rubtsy, Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic) and Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 21 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations. 📍 Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. The Groups' units inflicted losses on formations of two mechanised brigades, a mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and a marine brigade near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Cherevkovka, and Druzhkovka of the Donetsk People's Republic. ▪️ The enemy lost up to 165 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 24 motor vehicles, and three artillery g
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30269

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, and an airmobile brigade of the AFU close to Rubezhnoye, Metallovka, and Berezhnoye in Kharkov region.
💥
In Sumy region, formations of three mechanised brigades of the AFU were hit near Khoten, Ivolzhanskoye, and Nikolskoye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 165 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one radar station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Rubtsy, Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic) and Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 21 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
The Groups' units inflicted losses on formations of two mechanised brigades, a mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and a marine brigade near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Cherevkovka, and Druzhkovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 165 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 24 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements engaged manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Krivorozhye, Belozerskoye, Novopavlovka, Varvarovka, Novodonetskoye, Malotaranovka, Krinitsy, and Starovarvarovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
